        build-configuration: [ Debug, Release ]

      PUBLISH: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' && matrix.os == 'windows-latest' && matrix.build-configuration == 'Release' }}

      - name: Setup/Install the .NET SDKs
        id: install-netsdk
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v5
        with:
          dotnet-version: |
            8.0.x
            10.0.x

      - if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        name: Setup MSBuild
        id: setup_msbuild
        uses: microsoft/setup-msbuild@v3

      - name: Checkout repository
        id: checkout_repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          submodules: recursive
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Get semantic version from csproj
        id: semantic_version
        shell: pwsh

          $xml = [xml](gc MimeKit/MimeKit.csproj)
          $SEMANTIC_VERSION_NUMBER = $xml.Project.PropertyGroup.VersionPrefix

          Write-Host "version_num=${VERSION_NUM}"
          [IO.File]::AppendAllText($env:GITHUB_OUTPUT, "version_num=${VERSION_NUM}$([Environment]::NewLine)")

      - name: Run .NET restore
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          dotnet restore $env:SOLUTION_PATH

      - name: Run .NET tool restore

          dotnet tool restore

        id: run_unit_tests
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: pwsh

          & ./scripts/test.ps1 -Configuration "$env:BUILD_CONFIGURATION" -GenerateCodeCoverage "$env:GENERATE_CODE_COVERAGE"

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
